title: Success Path in else
prompt: Refactor: keep the try block containing ONLY the risky conversion, move the success print into else, and keep the error print in except. Output must stay identical for both a valid and an invalid value.

tests.name: else used correctly
tests.code:
assert printed == ["ok: 9"], f"got {printed}"
assert "else:" in code, "move the success print into an else block"
tests.hint: try: number = int(value) / except ValueError: ... / else: print("ok:", number)
